screened_out.reason: Technically strong and actively maintained, but official documentation states Dart bindings are Apache-2.0 while the native runtime uses the ObjectBox Binary License. The local database is free, but this mixed licensing is a weaker fit for a reusable open-source Library default. Retained as a future alternative, not misclassified as fully Apache-2.0.

human_recommendation.reason: Best combination of open provenance, maturity, Android/desktop coverage, transactions, migrations, testing and ecosystem neutrality.
human_recommendation.alternative_reason: Prefer for object-centric NoSQL persistence when a fully open Apache-2.0 native stack is more useful than relational SQLite semantics.

limitations: storage.local_db.v1 is currently only a draft logical Library contract; no unstated CRUD/schema API semantics were invented
No candidate code or release binary executed
Native artifact reproducibility was not independently verified
Upstream CI workflow/config presence is evidence, not a claim every upstream job is currently green
outcome: Two independent candidates shortlisted. Drift is the preferred general-purpose local persistence candidate; Isar Community is the open-source NoSQL alternative. ObjectBox is screened but not shortlisted because its native runtime uses a separate binary license.
